verdict.rationale: Runpod's Pod pricing docs offer committed-use discounts: users can commit upfront to a 3-month or 6-month term for compute discounts. The pricing page adds reserved capacity and contract pricing through enterprise sales. Missing for 10: specific discount rates and eligible GPU types, documentation that a commitment guarantees reserved capacity rather than only a lower price, self-serve reservation workflow details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can lock in reserved or committed-use discounts for sustained GPU capacity

citations.quote: Commit to a 3-month or 6-month term upfront for significant discounts on compute costs.
For reserved capacity and contract pricing, speak to our enterprise sales team.
